senses.gloss: tongs, pinchers, Sot. 19ᵇ כ׳ של ברזל (Alf. ק׳) iron tongs (to force her mouth open; Tosef. ib. II, 3 צבת).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 3:11">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 11</cite> some ed., v. <cite ref="K00681"><he>כַּלְבָּה</he></cite>.
